caption:
On the backroads of the highlands, mountain biking in Costa Rica means finding yourself on tracks built for horses and coffee harvests, not cars. Here, the forest presses in from both sides, smelling of damp earth and wild ginger after a morning rain. There are no long, flat stretches to rest the legs; the terrain is either climbing into the mist or dropping sharply to the valley floor. It asks for your full attention, but rewards you with a silence broken only by the hum of your tires on wet gravel.
